links.outcome: Microorganisms missed by AI-selected image galleries in Pap tests
links.effect: Sensitivity was 95.4% overall and 82.5% for HSV. Among 12 missed cases, 3 of 5 Candida and 3 of 7 HSV organisms were not shown in the 60 AI-selected images.
links.quote: Among the 12 cases with missed diagnoses, 3 of 5 Candida spp and 3 of 7 HSV organisms were not presented within the 60 images selected by HGDDS.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and image selection patterns of the commercial Hologic Genius Digital Diagnostics System for detecting microorganisms on Pap test slides reviewed by cytologists/cytopathologists.
